from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
base=Path('.').resolve(); p=Path('research_operating_design_2026-10-12')
sha=lambda f:hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
freeze=json.loads((p/'INTEGRATION_FREEZE.json').read_text())
protected=('udt_native_onshell_timelive_reset_owner_audit_2026-08-10/','udt_pair_regime_flow_reciprocal_orchestra_amplification_2026-08-12/','udt_sne_xmax_G88_am_radial_compatibility_atlas_2026-08-12/','udt_kernel_plane_global_curvature_holonomy_atlas_2026-08-02/')
for s in freeze['accepted_sha256']:
 assert not Path(s).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(s).parts and not s.startswith(protected),s
for s,h in freeze['accepted_sha256'].items(): assert sha(s)==h,s
record=json.loads(Path('development_reconstruction_2026-09-29/REVIEW_RECORD.json').read_text())
assert record['accepted_sha256']==freeze['accepted_sha256']
for r in record['reviewers']:
 d=json.loads(Path(r['attestation']).read_text())
 assert d['context']==r['context'] and d['verdict']=='ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITS'
 assert d['accepted_sha256']==record['accepted_sha256']
 assert sha(r['attestation'])==r['sha256'] and sha(d['report_path'])==d['report_sha256']
expected={'LIVE.md','HANDOFF.md','UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md','README.md','development_reconstruction_2026-09-29/REVIEW_RECORD.json'}
actual=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','HEAD'],text=True).splitlines())
assert actual==expected,actual
old=json.loads((p/'BASELINE.json').read_text())['existing_untracked_names_only']
names=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines()
unrelated=[s for s in names if not s.startswith(str(p)+'/') and s!='UDT_RESEARCH_OPERATING_PLAN.md']
assert sorted(unrelated)==sorted(old)
links=0
files=[Path('UDT_RESEARCH_OPERATING_PLAN.md'),Path('README.md'),Path('UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md')]+sorted(p.rglob('*.md'))
for f in files:
 for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',f.read_text()):
  if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'): continue
  target=re.sub(r':\d+$','',target.split('#')[0])
  origin=Path('UDT_RESEARCH_OPERATING_PLAN.md') if f==p/'INITIAL_PLAN.md' else f
  assert (origin.parent/target).exists(),(str(f),target)
  links+=1
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','frozen_hashes':len(freeze['accepted_sha256']),'local_links':links,'tracked_changes':sorted(actual),'unrelated_names_preserved':len(old),'scope':'Byte/routing/preservation correspondence only; no scientific reproof.'},indent=2))
